'''VT-211''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used by [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] in her [[Fury-class starfighter|''Fury''-class starfighter]] in [[137 ABY]]. She used his assistance during her activities in [[Operation: Thunderstroke]].
